title: Ordinary closed comparison through closure and section presentation
statement: Fix the finite-field datum $D$, a prime $\ell\ne D.p$, a realization family $R$, and a separated finite-type model $X$ [lem-sf-adic-qbar-constructible-realization, lem-sf-weil-native-exceptional-forgetful]. Let $N$ be any native closed comparison with its compatibility equations and normalized ordinary representative tensor and Hom models [lem-sf-weil-native-closed-forgetful]. Let $Q$ be direct image along the specified closure isomorphism followed by the ordinary section-module derived equivalence. Then there are natural tensor and Hom comparison isomorphisms from the ordinary closed model of $N$ through $Q$ to the realized ordinary closed model. At every $(A,B)$ the Hom comparison is exactly the target tensor-Hom transpose of inverse tensor comparison followed by $Q$ of ordinary evaluation. No choice of native right adjoint or dualizing object is involved.

source.place: Native dual comparison step 3: ordinary presentation transport and normalized evaluation transpose.

proof.text: Use the specified closure isomorphism and the section-module realization equivalence; their exactness preserves K-flat total tensor and K-injective product-total Hom. The ordinary representative models in N identify its tensor and Hom with these actual constructions. The localization factors give natural comparisons on all derived morphisms.

The componentwise uncurrying equation in the representative tensor-Hom normalization identifies the Hom arrow with the transpose of inverse tensor comparison followed by mapped evaluation. Thus the comparisons have the displayed normalization. This uses the same signs and includes zero objects and empty schemes.

proof_origin.place: Explicit interface refinement of native dual comparison step 3

theorem ordinary_closed_presentation (N : NativeClosedComparison D.k₀ l X.base.left)
    (hN : N.Compatible) :
    let Q := (ProEtale.adicLowerStar l (closureMap D X)).rightDerivedFunctor ⋙
      sectionDerived l (geometric D X).base.left (R.data (geometric D X)).realization
    letI := (R.data (geometric D X)).units
    let Z := (R.data (geometric D X)).tensor.closed
    ∃ t : N.ordinaryClosed.tensor ⋙ Q ≅ Q.prod Q ⋙ Z.tensor,
    ∃ h : N.homModels.ordinaryHom ⋙ Q ≅
        Q.op.prod Q ⋙
          ambientHom l (geometric D X).base.left (R.data (geometric D X)).realization,
    ∀ A B, (h.app (op A, B)).hom = Z.transpose _ _ _
      ((t.app (N.homModels.ordinaryHom.obj (op A, B), A)).inv ≫
        Q.map (N.ordinaryClosed.evaluation A B))
